uplink.description: 0x5a Pulse 4 datalog - channel A: newest total 295, prior samples, timestamped
uplink._note: Datalog frames are single-channel: one channels[] entry (label channelA) carrying pulse.total plus the counterHistory extra (no per-sample time exists, so no reserved history array). Status flags stay top-level.

uplink.description: 0x46 Pulse 4 data: channel A total 295, channel B total 1000, no timestamp
uplink._note: The 0x46 frame carries both metering inputs in one uplink: one channels[] entry per input, both mapping to pulse.total (channel B is no longer a suffixed extra).

uplink.description: Keep-alive frame (0x30) carries no counter and is rejected
